figurative_meaning_en: extremely cheap or at a very low price
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মাটির দরে সেই দামি ঘড়িটা কিনে ফেলেছে।
বাজারে ফলগুলো মাটির দরেই পাওয়া যাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He bought that expensive watch at a dirt-cheap price.
The fruits are available in the market at rock-bottom prices.
note: This idiom draws from agrarian contexts where soil represents basic, low value, emphasizing affordability in rural or semi-rural trade.
